 Order

Learned counsel for the petition er filed a memo which reads as under:
"The petitioner filed above petition seeking to quash proceedings against him in Spl.Case No.7/2022.
During admis sion, the Hon'ble Court did not extend benefit of stay, as such the trial Court proceeded and framed charge and evidence of victim is also recorded.
Hence this petition does not survive for consideration."
2. In view of the memo, petition is dismissed as withdrawn a s th e charge has been framed and trial has commenced.
3. All the defences available to the petition er is kept op en to be urged during the pending trial.
